title: Round 22: round 18's DAgger students on net1 v6's means only (arm A2)
description: Does net1's stated uncertainty help the learned net2 that passed? So far a net2 on the means of net1's beliefs (arm A2) did as well as one on the full beliefs (A3), but only in local TD3+BC runs on net1 v3. Round 22 trains round 18's recipe unchanged (DAgger gate3 students learning p and q, teacher gain 0.5, seeds 1 to 3, net1 v6 from release exp-net1v6-149, its rule at u = 0.25) with the actor reading net1's seven means instead of its 7 x 32 pooled bins. Its three seeds' ensemble, with q vetoing the push, is then evaluated beside r18e05 (A3) on every validation family. Validation links only.
run: S="$OUT/spec-r22-s$SEED.json"; jq --argjson seed "$SEED" '.algo = "dagger" | .student = "gate3" | .base = "fixed" | .view = "means" | .share_k = 0.5 | .gate_threshold = 0.5 | .critic_warmup = 0 | .lr = 0.001 | .updates_per_iteration = 50 | .replay_iterations = 16 | .tau_s = 1 | .noise_sigma = 0.05 | .group = 1 | .links_per_iteration = 32 | .compete = 0.8 | .copies = [2, 4] | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 60 | .eval_every = 20' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-r22-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
